calls.title: David DAngelo and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies to enhance guest qualification for their podcast by concentrating on roles in product management and data science to gain valuable insights into A/B testing. Ashley highlighted the importance of engaging teams that are more involved in testing, as engineers typically prefer building to testing. The outreach language will emphasize A/B testing conversations, requiring guests to run at least five A/B tests. A structured vetting process led by Geoffrey will qualify potential guests, with existing ones also reviewed for their alignment with the podcast’s focus. The podcast format will become more flexible, simplifying the question framework to allow for natural discussions. Additionally, the team aims to prioritize US companies while selectively engaging European firms, coupled with plans for monthly updates on customer lists to prevent outreach overlap.
calls.keywords: AB testing, product management, podcast guest qualification, outreach strategy, interview preparation, customer pipeline
